title: 一个人沿着廊下走
summary: The steward has been called away to see guests off; the young woman walks the veranda alone, unhurried, her face turned toward the row of photographs on the right-hand wall.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the same veranda further in; on the EAST wall at the right of frame a row of old photographs in deep wooden frames runs away along the depth, their glass catching the afternoon light; 苏小满 (S1) walks the veranda alone, unhurried, side-on to camera with her face toward the right-hand wall; 小罗 (S7) has just been called away to see the guests off and is no longer in frame; the blue brick floor and the corridor curb hold the bottom third, and afternoon light through the west balustrade falls in strips across her path.
[Shot 1] Medium, moving with her along the depth axis: 苏小满 (S1) walks the veranda slowly, the pace of someone with nothing to do but walk; her body is turned three-quarters to camera and her face is toward the right-hand wall.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.600, medium: on the east wall at the right of frame the row of deep-framed old photographs slides past one by one, their glass catching the afternoon light, while the west balustrade cuts the light into strips across the brick at her feet.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, wide along the veranda: she is a single small figure in the middle of a long corridor, the moon gate bright at the far end and the photograph wall running the whole right side of frame.
soundscape: Afternoon wind combing the courtyard leaves, her soft cloth shoe-falls on the blue brick, the faint creak of the timber balustrade, and the far-off murmur of guests at the front gate.

title: 墙上那排老照片
summary: She walks on with her face to the right-hand wall, her eyes sliding over the framed photographs one after another without stopping, dust lying thin on the frames.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) walks the veranda turned three-quarters to camera, her face toward the east wall at the right of frame, where the deep-framed photographs run away along the depth.
[Shot 1] Medium: the camera tracks with her as she walks; her eyes slide over the framed photographs without stopping, one after another, her face held toward the right-hand wall.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on one frame as she passes: dust lies thin on the top edge of the deep wooden frame, and the glass shows a soft reflection of the veranda light.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, medium again: her step does not slow, her hands at her sides, and the bottom third of frame is the blue brick and the corridor curb.
soundscape: Her soft shoe-falls on blue brick, dust shifting on the frame edges, afternoon wind through the west balustrade, and a bird crossing the courtyard once.

title: 工程奠基，大桥剪彩，捐资助学
summary: Three old photographs slide past beside her: a ground-breaking, a bridge opening, and a school donation — all yellowed and dusty, and her step never stops.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) walks the veranda with her face toward the right-hand wall, the photographs passing one by one beside her.
[Shot 1] Medium: the first photograph slides past — a group of men in Zhongshan suits standing on open ground before a stone tablet draped with red silk; her eyes pass over it without stopping.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, the second and third photographs pass together — one shows a steel-truss bridge with a red ribbon and a row of raised hands, the next shows dozens of children standing before an old bus holding identical school bags.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, close on her profile and the frames: all three photographs are old and yellowed and carry a thin film of dust on their deep wooden frames; her step has not stopped.
soundscape: Her unhurried shoe-falls on blue brick, dust brushing off the frame glass, afternoon wind along the balustrade, and the courtyard's far-off birdsong.

title: 脚步停在旧照片前
summary: She swings half a step on as if to walk past, then stops dead on the spot — a stop she had not planned — and turns a little more square to one frame.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) walks on past the yellowed photographs, her face toward the right-hand wall, her hands at her sides.
[Shot 1] Low, tight on the bottom third: her cloth toe swings forward half a step as if to walk on, then stops dead; the front of the foot halts and the back foot slowly comes up level, and her shadow on the brick stops with her.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, tight on her worn cloth shoe-tip aimed at one particular spot on the wall — a stop she had not planned.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.200, medium: her body has turned a little more square to the right-hand wall, her face tipped up toward one frame; the photographs run away from her along the depth and the moon gate stays bright far behind.
soundscape: Her shoe sole scuffing once on the blue brick, the faint tap of a frame against the wall, afternoon wind through the balustrade, and the far murmur of the house.

title: 二十二年前的江城大桥
summary: The frame she has stopped before holds the Jiangcheng bridge of twenty-two years ago, shot from the water — and the glass carries a crack and two scratches.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands stopped before one deep-framed photograph on the right-hand wall, her body turned square to it and her face tipped up.
[Shot 1] Near, angled from her profile to the photograph: the framed picture shows the Jiangcheng bridge of twenty-two years ago, shot from the water, the span crossing the frame with yellow-brown river beneath it.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.400, close on the wooden frame and glass: a fine crack runs along one edge of the frame and two scratches cross the glass, while her half-profile holds the right edge of frame, lit from the side.
soundscape: Afternoon wind in the balustrade close by, her slow breath as she looks, the faint settling of the old wooden frames, and the courtyard leaves beyond.

title: 那个很旧很特别的桥墩
summary: In the photograph one pier at the foot of the bridge stands apart from the rest — an older, rarer shape, its lower half still carrying the scar of old timber formwork and a corner missing from its top.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands before the framed photograph of the Jiangcheng bridge with her eyes on it.
[Shot 1] Close in on the photograph: at the foot of the bridge one pier stands out from the rest — not the usual round or square pier but an older, rarer shape, its lower half still carrying the scar of old timber formwork and old stone coursing, with one corner missing from its top.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, close on 苏小满's (S1) half-profile at the right edge of frame, her eyes fixed on that pier, the dust on the glass softening the light across her face.
soundscape: A low breath in close to the glass, afternoon wind in the courtyard leaves, the light creak of the frame on its nail, and the far murmur of the house.

title: 眼睛慢慢睁大
summary: Her brows move once — she has recognised it and cannot believe it — then her eyes widen a little at a time and her lashes hold still; her lips part but no sound comes.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands before the framed bridge photograph with her half-profile at the right edge of frame and her eyes on the old pier.
[Shot 1] Close on her face: her brows move once — she has recognised it and cannot believe it; then her eyes widen a little at a time and her lashes hold still without blinking.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, closer: her breathing shallows by a beat and something moves in her throat; her lips part a hair but no sound comes, and the afternoon light lies across half her face and shows her pupils clearly.
soundscape: Her breath going shallow against the glass, one bird calling across the courtyard, afternoon wind in the balustrade, and the low settle of the old corridor.

title: 这个桥墩
summary: She leans half a step in until her face is almost against the glass and says four words so soft they are almost only breath, while her fingertip points at the pier through the glass.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满's (S1) eyes are wide and fixed on the old pier in the framed photograph, her lips slightly parted.
[Shot 1] Near, 苏小满's (S1) half-profile close to the wall: she leans in half a step until her face is almost against the glass, and speaks four words low, so soft that they are almost only breath: [Chinese] 这个桥墩。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.400, close on her right hand: it comes up and her fingertip points at the pier through the glass — pressed toward it but not daring to touch.
soundscape: Four whispered words close to the glass, afternoon wind in the courtyard leaves, her sleeve brushing the frame, and the far murmur of the house behind her.

title: 外婆家那张照片里，就是这个桥墩
summary: Even lower than before, almost to herself, she says where she has seen that same pier — and her eyes flick away toward where she lives, her fingertip still on the glass.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) leans in close to the glass with her fingertip still pointing at the pier.
[Shot 1] Near, 苏小满's (S1) half-profile, her voice lower than before and almost as if to herself: [Chinese] 外婆家那张照片里，就是这个桥墩。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.400, close: on the words about the photograph at her grandmother's, her eyes flick away to the left-rear of frame — toward where she lives — and on the last words she says each one separately, confirming it to herself, her fingertip still on the glass.
soundscape: A voice dropped almost to breath against the glass, her fingertip resting on it, afternoon wind in the balustrade, and the distant low murmur of the house.

title: 二楼窗前
summary: High above, in the upper-right corner of frame, 陆崇 stands behind an old first-floor window with one hand on the frame, looking down at the small figure below.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands small in the lower part of frame before the right-hand photograph wall, her back and half-profile to camera, her fingertip toward the glass; the veranda runs away down the depth.
[Shot 1] Far, high angle from above: in the upper right corner of frame an old wooden window stands open in the upper wall, and 陆崇 (S15) stands behind it in a dark navy stand-collar jacket, one hand on the window frame, looking down.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, far, the frame split into layers: the window and his half figure in the upper two-thirds, the veranda below with 苏小满's (S1) small upturned figure on the blue brick in the lower part — the two of them stacked one above the other, a floor apart.
soundscape: One bird crossing the courtyard, the creak of the upper window frame, afternoon wind in the leaves below, and the low wooden settling of the corridor.

title: 看着她，很久没动
summary: Behind the dusty glass his eyes stay on the one figure stopped below, and he does not move at all; the two layers of frame hold perfectly still.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆崇 (S15) stands behind the upper window looking down; 苏小满 (S1) stands small below with her face turned up toward the photograph wall.
[Shot 1] Far on 陆崇 (S15) behind the window: his eyes are on the one figure stopped below and he does not move at all; a thin film of dust on the glass darkens his face.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, far, holding both layers: the window above and the small upturned figure below, both quite still, the afternoon light flat on the blue brick between them.
soundscape: The upper window frame easing in the wind, afternoon courtyard birdsong, the dry creak of the timber balcony, and the far murmur of the house below.

title: 苏小满，走了
summary: From the far end of the veranda a voice rings down the corridor; the steward stands half-length in the light of the moon gate with one hand lifted toward her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands below the photograph wall with her upturned face at the frame and her fingertip toward the glass; the veranda runs away from her toward the moon gate; 陆崇 (S15) is still up at the first-floor window above and behind her, out of this framing.
[Shot 1] Medium, from the far end of the depth: a voice comes down the veranda; 小罗 (S7) stands half-length in the light of the moon gate with one hand lifted toward her, and his call rings a little along the corridor.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, 小罗 (S7) calls down the veranda in Mandarin, and at the sound of it 苏小满's (S1) shoulders flinch: [Chinese] 苏小满，走了。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, medium: 苏小满 (S1) at the wall turns her head toward the far voice, her hand coming away from the glass.
soundscape: A voice called down a long wooden corridor, its ring off the far moon gate, 小罗's (S7) footstep on the brick, and afternoon wind through the balustrade.

title: 转身，走了两步
summary: She turns from the wall to face the far voice and takes two steps along the veranda, the photograph wall sliding past at the right of frame.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the photograph wall with her head turned toward the far voice, her hand coming away from the glass.
[Shot 1] Medium: she turns her body to face the far end of the veranda, toward where the voice came from, and takes two steps away from the wall; her shadow travels with her on the brick.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.800, wider down the depth: she walks two steps along the veranda and the photograph wall slides past at the right of frame.
soundscape: Her soft shoe-falls on blue brick, afternoon wind through the balustrade, the low creak of the rail, and the distant murmur of guests at the moon gate.

title: 第三步停住
summary: Her third step lifts and then comes down without leaving the ground — she stops in the middle of the corridor, facing away, and does not go on.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) has turned from the wall and taken two steps along the veranda toward the far end.
[Shot 1] Medium: her third step lifts and then comes down without ever leaving the ground — she stops.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on her back and shoulders as she stands still in the middle of the veranda, facing away down the depth, and does not go on.
soundscape: Her step halting on the blue brick, the wind easing through the balustrade, a soft creak of the timber rail, and the far murmur of the house.

title: 回头，再看一眼
summary: She turns back slowly, head first and body after, looks at that one photograph again from a distance, then turns properly away and walks off without looking back again.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands still in the middle of the veranda facing away down the depth, having stopped on her third step.
[Shot 1] Medium: she turns back slowly, head first and body after, and looks at that one photograph again from a distance; her eyes no longer widen, she simply looks steadily, storing the look of it.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, medium: she turns properly away this time and walks off down the veranda without looking back again; the photograph wall runs along the right of frame and the blue brick holds the bottom third.
soundscape: Her soft shoe-falls carrying her away down the brick, afternoon wind through the balustrade, the far voices at the moon gate, and a single piano note left hanging in the air.
music: A single suspended piano note, left hanging.
